description: This file contains utility functions and extensions for UI-related tasks in an Android app, including theme application, URI handling, QR code generation, string normalization, time formatting, and process management.

methods.name: getHintOverlayColor
methods.description: Returns a semi-transparent primary container color from the MaterialTheme color scheme.

methods.name: startActivitySafe
methods.description: Safely starts an activity with the given intent, catching and logging exceptions.

methods.name: applyNewTheme
methods.description: Sets the app theme to light, dark, or follow system based on the input string.

methods.name: openUriSafe
methods.description: Attempts to open a URI using UriHandler, catching and logging exceptions.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Removes diacritics from a string using Unicode normalization.

methods.name: generateQrBitmap
methods.description: Generates a QR code bitmap asynchronously from input data using ZXing library.

methods.name: asRelativeTimeString
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a human-readable relative time string.

methods.name: flagEmoji
methods.description: Converts a two-letter country code into a flag emoji.

methods.name: addressForUi
methods.description: Returns a simplified version of the repository address for UI display.

methods.name: canStartForegroundService
methods.description: Checks if the app can start a foreground service based on battery optimizations and app state.

methods.name: isAppInForeground
methods.description: Determines if the app is currently in the foreground.
